_comment: SmartCuff GUI update manifest. Fetched by the installed GUI over plain
public HTTPS -- there is deliberately NO credential in the client. See
README.md for why an embedded token was rejected.
This file is the ONLY thing the updater needs to read. Keep it small and
keep it valid JSON: a malformed manifest must fail soft in the client, but
there is no reason to rely on that.
The installer is a GitHub Release asset rather than a repository blob.
Keep installer_url version-specific: an existing manifest must always
resolve to the exact immutable bytes whose size and SHA-256 it declares.
notes:
Smart Const, Regular and High Max now distribute low-pressure measured-rate valve decisions continuously across their existing decision window. Matched 72 bpm/1.25 mL bench checks reduce maximum 8-15 mmHg duty steps from 2.00/2.00/1.68 to 0.14/0.11/0.13 points, preserving calibration, limits and safety. CVP and Valinor Max profiles are unchanged.

MAP arithmetic runs faster with identical original-cohort replay results. Smart Const keeps MAP+5 reinflation and hold. 40/72/150 bpm product checks complete with uninterrupted native sample timelines; buffered NI delivery recovery retains acquisition timestamps.

Includes the existing Simulator layout, paired BP queues, automatic recording closure, green/red trial status, recordings folder, aggregate CSV and MAP scatter. MAP reference is calculated from SP/DP, not independently measured arterial MAP. Original entry-transient outlier, remaining rate/volume error and single-device validation limits are documented.

Protected firmware flash and calibration restore passed. Seed 213 ten-minute soak: 6/6 complete, 100% exact telemetry delivery, no flags, all independently scored actuator reversal checks pass. Soak maximum low-pressure steps .18/.14 Smart, .14 Regular, .13 High Max duty points.
_channel_note: stable is the only channel today. If a test channel is ever added, publish
a second manifest (version-beta.json) rather than adding branching logic to
the client -- the client stays a dumb fetch-and-compare.
